name: frontend-lead
description: Lead-frontend-engineer workflow for Next.js/React/TypeScript: planner, builder, tester, docs and reviewer subagents with hook-enforced role boundaries, verify and review gates, engineering standards and project tooling templates.

strict_delegation.title: Strict delegation
strict_delegation.description: When on, the main session (lead) may only write docs; all code must go through builder, tester and refactorer subagents.

review_gate.title: Review gate
review_gate.description: Block finishing a turn when code changed and no reviewer subagent ran afterwards.

verify_on_stop.title: Verify on stop
verify_on_stop.description: Run typecheck, lint and related tests on changed files before the lead can finish a turn.

lint_on_edit.title: Format and lint on edit
lint_on_edit.description: Run Prettier and ESLint --fix on every edited file and send remaining errors back immediately.
